task.description: Validate test design coverage for IN-UI-01..04 as hard gate before TEST-RUNNER. Enforce MUST requirement runnable integration/E2E coverage and test isolation directives.
acceptance_criteria: Each MUST requirement has runnable test coverage
No skip/deferred patterns on MUST requirements
Fixtures are isolated and tests self-sufficient

result.summary: Hard-gate FAIL for IN-UI-01..04 test design validation. Requirement-level E2E coverage exists, but mandatory completeness, fixture isolation, cleanup, self-sufficiency, and security checks are not fully satisfied.

issues.description: Coverage completeness gap: specs define 8 test cases across IN-UI-01..04, but only 4 implemented requirement-mapped Playwright test blocks were found in web/tests/e2e/f3-instance-monitoring.e2e.spec.ts.
Fixture isolation violation: shared mutable fixtures are created in test.beforeAll and reused across tests, instead of per-test isolated fixture setup.
Cleanup hard gate failed: no afterEach/afterAll cleanup is present for created definitions and instances, so fixture cleanup is not guaranteed on failure paths.
Per-test UUID policy failed: fixture identifiers use Date.now()-derived values rather than UUID-based per-test identifiers.
Security violation: test source hardcodes credentials (KEYCLOAK_USERNAME and KEYCLOAK_PASSWORD) in web/tests/e2e/f3-instance-monitoring.e2e.spec.ts.
Self-sufficiency gap: test assumes externally running infrastructure and does not start backend/IDP services or call a documented setup-health helper.

result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for rework (Step 3) and return to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b) after fixes.
